changeSet.author: yakushev
changeSet.sql: create table data.futures_metrics ( id serial, metric_name text not null, metric_table text not null, constraint pk_futures_metrics primary key (id), constraint uk_futures_metrics_name unique (metric_name) );

changeSet.author: yakushev
changeSet.sql: create table data.futures_metrics_meta ( id serial, execute_every_mins int4 not null, id_futures_metrics int4 not null constraint fk_futures_metrics_meta_fut_met references data.futures_metrics(id), filter_window_min int4 not null, compare_interval_min int4 not null, filter_total_oi numeric not null, price_change_threshold numeric not null, oi_change_threshold numeric not null, constraint pk_futures_metrics_meta primary key (id) ); create index idx_futures_metrics_meta_id_fut_met on data.futures_metrics_meta(id_futures_metrics);

changeSet.author: yakushev
yakushev
changeSet.sql: create table data.futures_data_price_oi_metrics ( ts_db timestamp default localtimestamp not null, id_futures_metrics_meta int4 not null constraint fk_fut_data_pom_meta references data.futures_metrics_meta(id), id_futures_metrics_groups int4 not null constraint fk_fut_data_pom_group references data.futures_metrics_groups(id), cnt int8 null, pct_of_analyzed_by_count numeric null, total_oi_usdt numeric null, prcnt_oi numeric null ); create index idx_fdpom_meta_ts on data.futures_data_price_oi_metrics(id_futures_metrics_meta, ts_db);

changeSet.author: yakushev
changeSet.sql: create table data.futures_data_price_oi_metrics_symbol ( ts_db timestamp default localtimestamp not null, id_futures_metrics_meta int4 not null constraint fk_fut_data_pom_sym_meta references data.futures_metrics_meta(id), id_symbol int4 not null constraint fk_fut_data_pom_fs references data.symbol_futures(id), id_futures_metrics_groups int4 not null constraint fk_fut_data_pom_grp_group references data.futures_metrics_groups(id), total_oi_usdt numeric null, prcnt_oi numeric null ); create index idx_fdpmos_meta_ts on data.futures_data_price_oi_metrics_symbol(id_futures_metrics_meta, ts_db);
